problem: Too many orders come back, and every return costs shipping, fees and damaged stock, so the margin keeps shrinking.
solution: Read the return reasons every week, fix sizes and photos that set the wrong expectation, improve packing to stop damage, and pause ads on products that keep coming back.
title: Returns are eating my margin
items: Read the return reasons every week
Fix sizes and photos that mislead

problem: Ads, listings, creatives and the website are split across different freelancers, and when sales drop nobody owns the problem.
solution: Write down who owns each task, make one person responsible for results, keep one shared weekly report, and hold one short weekly review with everyone.
title: Five freelancers, nobody in charge
items: Write down who owns each task
Pick one person to own the results

topic: Same ad used until people stop responding
problem: The same ads have run for months and people have stopped clicking, so results keep falling.
solution: Watch whether clicks drop week on week, make fresh creatives every few weeks, test new hooks rather than only new colours, and retire ads people no longer click.
title: My ads have stopped working
items: Check if clicks are dropping week on week
Make fresh creatives every few weeks
Test new hooks, not just new colours
Retire ads people no longer click
line: MarketOps can help keep your ads fresh.
